items.text: A variant containing a reachable blocker produces verdict BLOCK.
A variant with only should-fix findings produces FIX-THEN-COMMIT, not BLOCK and not CLEAR.
A variant with only concrete nits keeps them advisory; nits never become an implicit commit veto.
An unrelated pre-existing failure is not fabricated as a finding attributable to the diff.
A required deterministic check newly failing because of the diff is surfaced as gate failure and reflected in the verdict.
A required check that cannot run or is inconclusive is reported as inconclusive evidence, not as pass or fabricated failure.
